^(configSchema)$.description:
A JSON Schema for the adapter's configuration, as JSON; empty if it
 takes none.

^(protocolVersion)$.description:
The major version of this service the adapter speaks. The adapter
 library fills it in; the core refuses an adapter whose version it does
 not support. Absent (0) means 1, the version before this field; once 1
 is dropped, an adapter that sends nothing is refused.

^(takesAdapterMapping)$.description:
Whether the adapter takes an adapter mapping (ADR 14). Once
 SourceSpec.adapter_mapping exists (stream O), a Source for such an
 adapter will have to set it, and a Source for any other adapter will
 have to leave it unset; boot will refuse either mismatch, naming both.
 Nothing enforces it yet.

^(webhookSignature)$.description: How deliveries are signed; set when webhooks is.

access.description:
The access the adapter needs in the source, in words, such as
 "read repository metadata".

config_schema.description:
A JSON Schema for the adapter's configuration, as JSON; empty if it
 takes none.

emits.description: The kinds the adapter emits, such as "Repository".

protocol_version.description:
The major version of this service the adapter speaks. The adapter
 library fills it in; the core refuses an adapter whose version it does
 not support. Absent (0) means 1, the version before this field; once 1
 is dropped, an adapter that sends nothing is refused.

takes_adapter_mapping.description:
Whether the adapter takes an adapter mapping (ADR 14). Once
 SourceSpec.adapter_mapping exists (stream O), a Source for such an
 adapter will have to set it, and a Source for any other adapter will
 have to leave it unset; boot will refuse either mismatch, naming both.
 Nothing enforces it yet.

vocabulary.description:
The terms the adapter publishes in its own namespace (ADR 13). Every
 source that runs the adapter publishes the same module. Absent: the
 adapter emits today's names, read as core terms.

webhook_signature.description: How deliveries are signed; set when webhooks is.

bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.ModuleSource.sc.description: ModuleSource is where a module came from, so a term row can say so.

commit.description: The full commit SHA the module was read or built at.

path.description: The module's path in the repository.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the module file, hex; empty when not pinned.

bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.ModuleSource.sc.title: Module Source

bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.VocabularyModul.description:
VocabularyModule is the terms one owner publishes in one namespace, at one
 version (ADR 13). A term only grows: a later version may add terms, never
 change or narrow one.

namespace.description:
A reverse domain, such as "io.k8s". "com.dougmccall.bearing.core" is the
 core's; a bare segment such as "k8s" is refused.

terms.description: The terms, each named once, without the namespace.

version.description:
The module's version, such as "0.4.0"; observations name it in
 module_version.

bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.VocabularyModul.title: Vocabulary Module

bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.VocabularyTerm..description: VocabularyTerm is one kind, relation or attribute.

^(valueType)$.description: An attribute's value type; unset for kinds and relations.
^(valueType)$.title: Value Type

cardinality.description: A predicate's cardinality; unset for kinds.
cardinality.title: Cardinality

conflict.description: A predicate's conflict policy; unset for kinds.
conflict.title: Conflict Policy

domain.description:
The kinds a predicate's subject may have, as full or core names. Empty:
 any kind.

name.description:
The name within the namespace: "Deployment" for a kind, lowercase
 letters, digits and "_" for a predicate. Required.

range.description: The kinds a relation's object may have. Empty: any kind.

value_type.description: An attribute's value type; unset for kinds and relations.
value_type.title: Value Type

bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.VocabularyTerm..title: Vocabulary Term

bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.WebhookSignatur.description:
WebhookSignature says how a source signs its webhook deliveries, so the
 core can check them before the adapter sees them.

^(signatureHeader)$.description: The header that carries the signature.

^(signaturePrefix)$.description: Text before the signature in that header, such as "sha256=".

scheme.description:
The scheme, as a model.v1alpha1.WebhookScheme name, such as
 "WEBHOOK_SCHEME_HMAC_SHA256".

signature_header.description: The header that carries the signature.

signature_prefix.description: Text before the signature in that header, such as "sha256=".

bearing.adapter.v1alpha1.WebhookSignatur.title: Webhook Signature
